answer: Clay is wedged on the bench, and the potter's wheel hums through the afternoon. Proof of potter clay via wheel throw count — a pot the potter throws only after 20 pots run true, each pot centred by the potter himself. The anchor guards the wet pots from the cold draught. The kernel sketches the shape the next firing will take. The yarrow stacks the bisque ware by the kiln door. A forger must throw 20 pots, centre 20 pots and prove 20 pots true, four weeks at the wheel for pots that still warp in the firing.
